description: Return static resources published as this identity's page.

path.description: Canonical path of the requested resource within the publisher's page.

maximumBytes.description: Largest resource content size in bytes that the visitor accepts.

path.description: Canonical path returned, exactly equal to the requested path.

mediaType.description: Lowercase type/subtype label for the returned content.

contentSize.description: Exact number of returned content bytes.

contentHash.description: Exact 32-byte SHA-256 hash of the returned content.

content.description: Complete static content bytes for the requested path.

price.description: Exact credits charged for the successful get invocation.

check.description: Locally verify that one complete get output matches its requested path, agreed price, declared size, media type, and SHA-256 content hash.

requestedPath.description: Canonical path supplied in the checked get invocation.

path.description: Canonical path contained in the checked output.

mediaType.description: Media type contained in the checked output.

contentSize.description: Declared byte length contained in the checked output.

contentHash.description: Declared 32-byte SHA-256 content hash contained in the checked output.

content.description: Complete content bytes contained in the checked output.

agreedPrice.description: Fixed offering price accepted before the checked invocation.

price.description: Price contained in the checked output.

outcome.description: Visitor-computed verification result: pass, fail, or inconclusive.
